sourceValues: 11.3 FT = run 1 7'-3 1/2" (7.292, Women's east wall, no door) + run 2 3.89 (Men's west wall net of Janitor door 115: 3.67 + 0.22)
formula: sum of the two yellow runs traced along the base of elevation A, one per restroom side wall
notes: Elevation A (10/A-410) is the Men's west wall; the door drawn in it is Janitor door 115, beside the CR card reader. Doors 113 (Men's) and 112 (Women's) are both in the south walls, 6" from the side wall, so the 'similar' Women's east wall has no door. Run 1 = Women's east wall full width (7.29), run 2 = Men's west wall net of door 115 (3.67 + 0.22 = 3.89); together 11.18 LF (-0.87%). By elevation width (7.292 - 3.0) + 7.292 = 11.58 (+2.7%); by plan depth (7.677 - 3.0) + 7.677 = 12.35 (+9.5%): the estimator scaled the elevation, whose 7'-3 1/2" differs from the plan's 7'-8 1/8".
